species: The MS raw files were analyzed using MaxQuant Software version 1.4.1.2 for peak detection, quantification and peptide identification using a full-length Uniprot Mouse database (April, 2016) and common contaminants such as keratins and enzymes used for digestion as reference.
sample_source: recombinant Cdk5/p35 (Millipore) was incubated with the GST-fused PER2 protein fragment.
strain: GST-fused recombinant Per2 proteins were expressed in the E. coli Rosetta strain [plasmids: GST-Per2 N-M (1-576), GST-Per2 M-C (577-1256)].
